scripts.build:docs: tsc && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('docs', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('dist', 'docs', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'docs/404.html'); fs.writeFileSync('docs/.nojekyll', ''); console.log('✓ Synced dist to docs/ with .nojekyll');"
scripts.predeploy: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html', 'dist/404.html'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/.nojekyll', '');"
